changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Optimistic-lock column for CashClose. Without it, two managers approving/rejecting the same close concurrently both pass the read-then-check-then-write in ApprovalServiceImpl#transition and one decision silently overwrites the other with no error to either reviewer.

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment:
Replaces the plain uq_cash_closes_branch_date_shift constraint (added in 1.0.0.2) with a partial unique index that excludes VOIDED rows.
The plain constraint had a real bug: it applied to every row regardless of status, so once a close was voided, that branch/date/shift slot could never be submitted into again — the second insert would 23505 forever, even though CashCloseServiceImpl#requireNoActiveClose (via findActiveByBranchAndDate) already excludes VOIDED and clearly intends voiding to free the slot for a fresh submission.
The partial index also gives requireNoActiveClose's application-level check a real backstop: two concurrent submits for the same branch/date/shift can both pass the SELECT-based pre-check, but only one INSERT will succeed — the loser gets a clean constraint violation the service layer maps to 409 Conflict (see CashCloseServiceImpl#submitCashClose).
Postgres-only (partial indexes aren't portable, and this app is Postgres-only per application.properties' spring.datasource.driver-class-name).
